description: This file implements a parser and serializer for Wesnoth Markup Language (WML), including functions for reading, writing, and processing WML documents in binary and text formats.

methods.name: read_literal_word
methods.description: Reads a literal word from a character array until a null byte is encountered.

methods.name: read_word
methods.description: Reads a word from character array, handling schema references, literals, and errors.

methods.name: add_child
methods.description: Creates a new child element with a given name and adds it to the document.

methods.name: read_binary
methods.description: Parses a binary WML document from input string, constructing a nested document structure.

methods.name: read_text
methods.description: Parses a WML document from text format, building a nested document structure.

methods.name: write_word_literal
methods.description: Serializes a word as a literal with a null terminator.

methods.name: write_word
methods.description: Serializes a word, using schema references if possible, or as a literal.

methods.name: write_binary_internal
methods.description: Recursively serializes a document into binary format.

methods.name: write_binary
methods.description: Serializes a document into binary format with schema optimization.

methods.name: write_text
methods.description: Serializes a document into human-readable text format.

methods.name: output_document
methods.description: Outputs a document in indented text format to standard output.

methods.name: has_child
methods.description: Checks if a document has a child with a specific name.

methods.name: get_children
methods.description: Retrieves all children with a specific name from a document.
